common.unreachable: {provider} could not be reached. Try again shortly.
common.rateLimited: {provider} is rate limiting requests. Try again later.
common.tooMuchData: The {provider} account has too much data to verify in one run.
common.notConfigured: {provider} verification is not configured correctly on this server.
common.notSetUp: {provider} is not set up on this server yet.
common.otherProviderKey: This key belongs to another payment provider. Paste your {provider} API key.
common.keyRevoked: {provider} rejected the key. It may have been revoked.
common.liveKeyOnly: Use a live {provider} key. Test keys are not accepted.
common.missingPermission: The key is missing a read permission.
common.missingPermissionDetail: The key is missing a read permission. {provider} says: {detail}
common.connectionRevoked: {provider} no longer accepts the connection. It may have been revoked; connect {provider} again.
common.connectionCannotRead: The {provider} connection cannot read what this verification needs. Connect {provider} again.
common.connectionNotCompleted: {provider} did not complete the connection. Try again.
common.keyUnreadable: The stored key is not readable. Connect the payment provider again.

check.ownSaasOnly: You can only verify revenue for your own SaaS.
check.recentlyChecked: Revenue was checked in the last few minutes. Try again later.
check.hourlyLimit: Revenue was checked many times in the last hour. Try again later.

connect.chooseProvider: Choose your payment provider. If it is not in the list, choose Other.
connect.otherNameMissing: Write the name of your payment provider.
connect.otherNameTooLong: {max, plural, one {Keep the payment provider under # character.} other {Keep the payment provider under # characters.}}
connect.oauthExpired: The connection to {provider} expired. Try again.
connect.oauthNotApproved: {provider} access was not approved, so nothing was connected.

run.keyReplaced: The key was replaced during the check, so this result was not stored.
run.disconnected: The provider was disconnected during the check, so this result was not stored.
run.otherProvider: The product is connected to another provider.
run.connectionNotLoaded: The connection could not be loaded.
run.disconnectFailed: The provider could not be disconnected. Please try again.
run.accountClaimed: This {provider} account already verifies another SaaS on The SaaS Harbor.
run.paymentsClaimed: Payments of this {provider} account already verify another SaaS on The SaaS Harbor.
run.paymentsTooDense: The {provider} account has more payments on one day than one read covers, so there is no revenue beyond MRR.
run.amountUnreadable: An amount could not be read.
run.ratesNotConfigured: Exchange rates are not configured correctly on this server.
run.ratesUnavailable: Exchange rates are unavailable right now. Try again shortly.

stripe.wrongKeyType: Use a restricted key (rk_...) with read-only permissions, never your secret or publishable key.
stripe.keyFormat: Paste a Stripe restricted key. It starts with rk_live_.
stripe.liveModeOnly: Use a live-mode key. Test keys are not accepted.
stripe.priceCurrency: The price {price} has no amount in {currency}.
stripe.revenuePermission: Revenue beyond MRR needs the {permission}: Read permission on the restricted key.
stripe.historyPermission: Revenue history needs the {permission}: Read permission on the restricted key.
stripe.historyTooLarge: The Stripe account has more invoices than one verification reads, so there is no revenue history.
stripe.deletedCoupons: {count, plural, one {# subscription has a coupon that was deleted in Stripe and can no longer be read, so it was not counted.} other {# subscriptions have coupons that were deleted in Stripe and can no longer be read, so they were not counted.}}
stripe.taxIncluded: {count, plural, one {# subscription's price includes tax that could not be taken out, since its latest invoice could not be read.} other {# subscriptions' prices include tax that could not be taken out, since their latest invoices could not be read.}}

paddle.legacyKey: This is a legacy Paddle key with full access to your account. Create a new API key with read permissions instead.
paddle.keyFormat: Paste a Paddle API key. It starts with pdl_live_apikey_.
paddle.sandboxKey: Use a live Paddle key. Sandbox keys are not accepted.
paddle.keyRejected: Paddle rejected the key. It may have expired or been revoked, or belong to the other environment.
paddle.billingNotEnabled: This Paddle account does not use Paddle Billing.
paddle.historyTooLarge: The Paddle account has more transactions than one verification reads, so there is no revenue history.

polar.wrongTokenType: Use an organization access token from your Polar settings. It starts with polar_oat_.
polar.tokenFormat: Paste a Polar organization access token. It starts with polar_oat_.
polar.tokenRejected: Polar rejected the token. It may have expired or been revoked.
polar.missingScope: The token is missing the {scope} scope.
polar.missingAnyScope: The token is missing a scope this verification needs.
polar.historyTooLarge: The Polar account has more orders than one verification reads, so there is no revenue history.

dodo.keyFormat: Paste a Dodo Payments API key.
dodo.keyRejected: Dodo Payments rejected the key. It may have been revoked, or belong to the other environment.
dodo.notAllowed: The key is not allowed to read what this verification needs.
dodo.tooManyTaxInclusive: The Dodo Payments account has more tax-inclusive subscriptions than one verification reads.
dodo.noHistory: Dodo Payments does not say which period a payment covers, so there is no revenue history.

creem.keyFormat: Paste a Creem API key. It starts with creem_.
creem.requestRefused: Creem refused the request. Check that the key is still active and can read products, subscriptions and transactions.
creem.tooManyProducts: The Creem account has more products than one verification reads.
creem.tooManyTaxInclusive: The Creem account has more tax-inclusive subscriptions than one verification reads.
creem.historyTooLarge: The Creem account has more transactions than one verification reads, so there is no revenue history.

chargebee.siteFormat: Enter your Chargebee site: the name before .chargebee.com in your dashboard's address.
chargebee.testSite: Use your live Chargebee site. Test sites are not accepted.
chargebee.keyRejected: Chargebee rejected the key. It may have been deleted, or belong to another site.
chargebee.cannotRead: The key cannot read subscriptions and invoices. Use a read-only key with access to all data or to transactional data.
chargebee.historyTooLarge: The Chargebee site has more invoices than one verification reads, so there is no revenue history.

whop.keyRejected: Whop rejected the key. It may have been deleted, or belong to the other environment.
whop.noAccount: Whop found no account for this key.
whop.canWrite: The key can do more than read, for example {permissions}. Create a key with only the read permissions listed.
whop.tooManyPlans: The Whop account has more plans than one verification reads.
whop.tooManyPromoCodes: The Whop account has more promo codes than one verification reads.
whop.historyTooManyPayments: The Whop account has more payments than one verification reads, so there is no revenue history.
whop.historyTooManyPlans: The Whop account has more plans than one verification reads, so there is no revenue history.

revenuecat.projectFormat: Enter your RevenueCat project ID, or paste the address of a page in your project.
revenuecat.publicKey: This is a public SDK key. Create a V2 secret API key in your project settings.
revenuecat.otherProvider: This key belongs to another payment provider. Paste your RevenueCat secret API key.
revenuecat.keyFormat: Paste a RevenueCat secret API key. It starts with sk_.
revenuecat.keyRejected: RevenueCat rejected the key. It may have been revoked, or be a V1 key rather than a V2 secret key.
revenuecat.cannotReadCharts: The key cannot read this project's charts. Check the project ID and give the key read access to Charts & metrics.
revenuecat.noProject: RevenueCat found no project with this ID.
revenuecat.preparingCharts: RevenueCat is still preparing this project's charts. Try again later.
revenuecat.beyondCharts: The key has more access than charts. Create a V2 secret API key with read access to Charts & metrics only.
revenuecat.noDailyChart: RevenueCat does not offer the {chart} chart by day.

gumroad.pasteRefused: Connect Gumroad with the Connect with Gumroad button. Gumroad's access tokens can change your account, so they are not accepted here.
gumroad.scopes: The Gumroad connection can do more than read sales, or cannot read them. Connect Gumroad again.
gumroad.otherAccess: Gumroad granted other access than reading sales, so the connection was not saved. Try again.
gumroad.historyTooLarge: The Gumroad account has more sales than one verification reads, so there is no revenue history.

paypal.clientIdFormat: Enter the Client ID of your PayPal app.
paypal.otherProvider: This key belongs to another payment provider. Paste the secret of your PayPal app.
paypal.secretFormat: Paste the secret of your PayPal app.
paypal.secretIsClientId: The secret is the Client ID again. Paste Secret key 1 of the app.
paypal.noTransactionSearch: The PayPal app cannot search transactions. Turn on Transaction search in the app's features. PayPal can take up to nine hours to apply a change to an existing app, so a new app is quicker.
paypal.beyondSearch: The PayPal app can do more than search transactions. Create an app with only Transaction search turned on, and paste its Client ID and secret.
paypal.credentialsRefused: PayPal refused the Client ID and secret. Check that both belong to the same app, created under Live.
paypal.noAccess: PayPal did not issue access for the app. Try again shortly.
paypal.accessRefused: PayPal refused the app's access. Try again shortly.
paypal.searchForbidden: The PayPal app cannot search transactions. Turn on Transaction search in the app's features.
paypal.historyTooLarge: The PayPal account has more subscription payments than one verification reads, so there is no revenue history.
paypal.yearly: {count, plural, one {# subscription counts as yearly until its next payment shows how often it renews.} other {# subscriptions count as yearly until their next payment shows how often they renew.}}

mollie.profileFormat: Enter the ID of this product's website profile in Mollie. It starts with pfl_.
mollie.otherProvider: This key belongs to another payment provider. Paste a Mollie advanced access token.
mollie.apiKey: This is a Mollie API key, which can also create payments and refunds. Create an advanced access token with read permissions only, and paste it instead.
mollie.tokenFormat: Paste a Mollie advanced access token. It starts with access_.
mollie.canWrite: The token can do more than read, for example {permissions}. Create an advanced access token with only the read permissions listed.
mollie.cannotRead: The token cannot read {missing, select, payments {payments} subscriptions {subscriptions} other {payments or subscriptions}}. Create an advanced access token with read permissions for payments and subscriptions.
mollie.tokenRejected: Mollie rejected the token. It may have been revoked, or have expired.
mollie.requestRefused: Mollie refused the request. Check that the token can read payments and subscriptions, and is limited neither to test mode nor to another website profile.
mollie.requestRefusedDetail: Mollie refused the request. Check that the token can read payments and subscriptions, and is limited neither to test mode nor to another website profile. Mollie says: {detail}
mollie.noProfile: Mollie found no website profile with this ID that the token can read.
mollie.historyTooLarge: The Mollie profile has more payments than one verification reads, so there is no revenue history.

paystack.secretKey: This is your Paystack secret key, which can do everything in your account. Create a restricted key with read scopes only, and paste that instead.
paystack.publicKey: This is your Paystack public key. Create a restricted key with read scopes, and paste that instead.
paystack.otherProvider: This key belongs to another payment provider. Paste a Paystack restricted key.
paystack.keyFormat: Paste a Paystack restricted key. It starts with rk_live_.
paystack.keyRejected: Paystack rejected the key. It may have been revoked, rotated or expired, or be another provider's key.
paystack.cannotRead: The key cannot read {list, select, subscriptions {subscriptions} plans {plans} transactions {transactions} refunds {refunds} other {this}}. Give it the {scope} scope on the Paystack dashboard.
paystack.historyTooLarge: The Paystack account has more transactions than one verification reads, so there is no revenue history.
paystack.historyScope: Revenue history needs the transactions:read scope on the restricted key.
paystack.unlisted: {count, plural, one {Paystack did not list # subscription to your plans, so MRR may leave it out.} other {Paystack did not list # subscriptions to your plans, so MRR may leave them out.}}

abacatepay.apiKey: This is an AbacatePay API key, which can do more than read. Turn on the Trust MRR app in your dashboard's Apps and paste its token, which starts with mrr_.
abacatepay.publicKey: This is AbacatePay's public key. Paste the token of the Trust MRR app, which starts with mrr_.
abacatepay.otherProvider: This key belongs to another payment provider. Paste your AbacatePay Trust MRR token.
abacatepay.tokenFormat: Paste the token of AbacatePay's Trust MRR app. It starts with mrr_.
abacatepay.tokenRejected: AbacatePay rejected the token. It may have been revoked, or the Trust MRR app turned off.
abacatepay.tokenRefused: AbacatePay refused the token access to the store's revenue. Check that the Trust MRR app is turned on.
abacatepay.noStore: AbacatePay did not say which store the token belongs to.

asaas.keyFormat: Paste an Asaas API key. It starts with $aact_.
asaas.sandboxKey: This is a Sandbox key. Create the key in your Asaas production account.
asaas.wrongEnvironment: The key belongs to the other Asaas environment. Production keys start with $aact_prod_.
asaas.keyRejected: Asaas rejected the key. It may have been deleted or expired, or disabled after three months without use.
asaas.missingPermission: The key cannot read everything verification needs. Give it Read access to Subscriptions and Charges.
asaas.missingPermissionDetail: The key cannot read everything verification needs. Give it Read access to Subscriptions and Charges. Asaas says: {detail}
asaas.requestRefused: Asaas refused the request. A key limited to certain IP addresses cannot be verified.
asaas.rateLimited: Asaas is limiting requests, or the account has used its requests for the last 12 hours. Try again later.
asaas.beyondAccess: The key can read more than subscriptions and charges, as a key created without permissions can: Asaas gives such a key full access. Create a key with only Read for Subscriptions and Charges.
asaas.historyTooLarge: The Asaas account has more subscriptions or charges than one verification reads, so there is no revenue history.

airwallex.clientIdFormat: Enter the Client ID shown with your Airwallex API keys.
airwallex.otherProvider: This key belongs to another payment provider. Paste your Airwallex scoped API key.
airwallex.keyFormat: Paste your Airwallex scoped API key.
airwallex.keyIsClientId: The key is the Client ID again. Paste the scoped API key.
airwallex.credentialsRefused: Airwallex refused the Client ID and API key. Check that both come from the API keys of your live account, and that the key has not been regenerated.
airwallex.ipLimited: Airwallex refused access for the key. If the key only works from some IP addresses, remove that limit.
airwallex.noAccess: Airwallex did not issue access for the key. Try again shortly.
airwallex.accessRefused: Airwallex refused the key's access. Try again shortly.
airwallex.cannotReadSubscriptions: The key cannot read subscriptions. Give it Read access to Subscriptions under Billing.
airwallex.cannotReadInvoices: The key cannot read invoices. Give it Read access to Invoices under Billing.
airwallex.cannotReadPayments: The key cannot read payments. Give it Read access to Payment Acceptance, for the one account that takes your payments.
airwallex.beyondAccess: The key can read more than subscriptions, invoices and payments, such as your balances or products. Create a scoped API key with Read access to Subscriptions, Invoices and Payment Acceptance only.
airwallex.tooManySubscriptions: The Airwallex account has more subscriptions than one verification reads.
airwallex.tooManyInvoices: The Airwallex account has more subscription invoices than one verification reads.
airwallex.historyTooLarge: The Airwallex account has more subscription invoices than one verification reads, so there is no revenue history.
airwallex.noSubscriptions: The Airwallex account has no active subscriptions in Airwallex Billing, so MRR is zero. Revenue still counts its payments.

superwall.applicationFormat: Enter your Superwall application ID, or paste the address of your app's dashboard.
superwall.publicKey: This is the app's public SDK key. Create an organization API key under Settings, API Keys.
superwall.otherProvider: This key belongs to another payment provider. Paste your Superwall organization API key.
superwall.keyFormat: Paste a Superwall organization API key. It starts with sk_.
superwall.keyRejected: Superwall rejected the key. It may have been revoked, or be the app's public SDK key rather than an organization API key.
superwall.cannotReadCharts: The key cannot read this app's charts. Check the application ID, give the key the charts:read scope, and give it access to the app's project.
superwall.noApp: Superwall found no app with this application ID.
superwall.beyondCharts: The key has more access than charts. Create an organization API key with only the charts:read scope.
superwall.noChart: Superwall does not offer the {chart} chart.
superwall.wrongFigures: Superwall's {chart} chart did not give the figures asked for.
superwall.noActives: Superwall does not offer the Active Subscriptions chart for this app, so subscribers are not counted.

appstore.p8Format: Paste the contents of the .p8 file you downloaded for the key.
appstore.privateKeyUnreadable: The private key could not be read. Paste the whole contents of the .p8 file.
appstore.notTeamKey: This is not an App Store Connect API key. Paste the contents of the .p8 file of a Team key.
appstore.issuerFormat: Enter the Issuer ID shown above your Team keys in App Store Connect.
appstore.keyIdFormat: Enter the Key ID of the API key: ten letters and digits.
appstore.vendorFormat: Enter your vendor number, shown in Payments and Financial Reports in App Store Connect.
appstore.otherProvider: This key belongs to another payment provider. Paste the contents of the .p8 file of your App Store Connect API key.
appstore.keyIdPasted: This is a Key ID. Paste the contents of the .p8 file you downloaded for the key.
appstore.unknownVendor: Apple does not recognize the vendor number for this key's team. Copy it from Payments and Financial Reports in App Store Connect.
appstore.keyRefused: Apple refused the key. Check that the Issuer ID, the Key ID and the private key belong to one active Team key. Individual keys cannot download sales reports.
appstore.cannotDownload: The key cannot download sales reports. Create a Team key with the Sales role and access to reports, or with the Finance role.
appstore.cannotRead: Apple did not let the key read {path}.
appstore.reportUnreadable: Apple sent a report that could not be read.
appstore.beyondReports: The key can do more than download reports, such as managing apps, certificates or reviews. Create a Team key with the Sales role and access to reports, or with the Finance role.
appstore.notPublished: Apple has not published the subscription reports of the last few days. Try again later.
appstore.missingColumns: An App Store report did not have the expected columns ({columns}).

googleplay.bucketFormat: Enter the Cloud Storage URI of your reports, from Download reports in Play Console. It starts with gs://pubsite_prod_.
googleplay.packageFormat: Enter the package name of your app, such as com.example.app, as Play Console shows it under the app's name.
googleplay.tooManyPackages: {max, plural, one {Enter at most # package name.} other {Enter at most # package names.}}
googleplay.defaultAccount: This is a default service account, which can manage your Google Cloud project. Create a new service account without roles and paste a JSON key of that one.
googleplay.notServiceAccount: The JSON key does not name a service account. Paste the whole JSON key of a service account.
googleplay.wholeKey: Paste the whole JSON key of the service account, as Google Cloud downloaded it. It starts with '{'.
googleplay.otherProvider: This key belongs to another payment provider. Paste the JSON key of your service account.
googleplay.googleApiKey: This is a Google API key. Paste the JSON key of a service account instead.
googleplay.privateKeyOnly: This is only the private key. Paste the whole JSON key file of the service account.
googleplay.personalCredentials: These are a person's Google credentials, which can do anything they can. Paste a JSON key of a service account instead.
googleplay.privateKeyUnreadable: The private key in the JSON key could not be read. Download a new JSON key for the service account.
googleplay.keyStrength: The JSON key does not hold an RSA key of 2048 to 4096 bits, as Google Cloud creates them. Download a new JSON key.
googleplay.tooLong: The JSON key and package names are too long to store. Use fewer package names.
googleplay.beyondReadOnly: Google gave the service account more access than reading Cloud Storage, so it was not used. Create a new service account without roles and paste a JSON key of that one.
googleplay.keyRefused: Google refused the service account's JSON key. It may have been deleted or disabled: create a new JSON key for the service account and paste it.
googleplay.noAccess: Google did not issue access for the service account. Try again shortly.
googleplay.tokenRefused: Google refused the access token. Try again shortly.
googleplay.apiDisabled: The Cloud Storage API is turned off in the service account's Google Cloud project. Turn on the Cloud Storage JSON API there.
googleplay.cannotReadReports: The service account cannot read the reports in this bucket. In Play Console, under Users and permissions, give it View financial data for the whole account. A new permission can take some hours to apply.
googleplay.noBucket: Google found no reports bucket with this name. Copy the Cloud Storage URI from Download reports in Play Console.
googleplay.reportUnreadable: A Google Play sales report could not be read. Try again later.
googleplay.reportColumns: A Google Play sales report does not have the columns verification reads.
googleplay.historyTooLarge: The Google Play sales reports of the last 25 months are larger than one verification reads, so there is no revenue history.
googleplay.missingSales: Google Play's reports of the last 13 months have no sales of {packages}. {several, select, yes {Check the package names.} other {Check the package name.}}
googleplay.yearly: {count, plural, one {# subscription counts as yearly until a renewal shows how often it renews.} other {# subscriptions count as yearly until a renewal shows how often they renew.}}

zoho.beyondRead: Zoho granted other access than reading subscriptions and payments, so it is not used. Connect Zoho Billing again.
zoho.connectionRevoked: Zoho no longer accepts the connection. It may have been revoked; connect Zoho Billing again.
zoho.noAccess: Zoho did not issue access for the connection. Try again shortly.
zoho.accessRefused: Zoho Billing refused the connection's access. It may have been revoked; connect Zoho Billing again.
zoho.dailyLimit: The Zoho Billing organization has used all of its API calls for today. Try again tomorrow.
zoho.unknownDataCentre: Zoho returned an unknown data centre, so nothing was connected.
zoho.notStorable: Zoho returned access in a form that could not be stored.
zoho.storedInvalid: The stored Zoho Billing connection is not valid. Connect again.
zoho.pasteRefused: Connect Zoho Billing by approving read access with Zoho. Pasted Zoho tokens are not accepted here.
zoho.noOrganization: The Zoho account has no Zoho Billing organization to read.
zoho.noHistory: Zoho Billing's invoice list does not say which subscription or period an invoice pays for, so there is no revenue history.

mercadopago.pasteRefused: Connect Mercado Pago with the Connect with Mercado Pago button. Mercado Pago's access tokens can change your account, so they are not accepted here.
mercadopago.connectionUnreadable: The Mercado Pago connection could not be read. Connect Mercado Pago again.
mercadopago.notFound: Mercado Pago could not find what this verification reads.
mercadopago.testAccount: This is a Mercado Pago test account. Connect the account that receives your payments.
mercadopago.notConfigured: Mercado Pago verification is not configured on this server.
mercadopago.noLongerAccepted: Mercado Pago no longer accepts the connection. Connect Mercado Pago again.
mercadopago.tooManyEnded: The Mercado Pago account has more ended subscriptions than one verification reads.
mercadopago.noSubscriptionNames: Mercado Pago's payments did not name the subscriptions they paid for, so there is no revenue history.
mercadopago.historyTooLarge: The Mercado Pago account has more payments or subscriptions than one verification reads, so there is no revenue history.
mercadopago.accessExpired: The Mercado Pago access has expired. The next verification renews it.
mercadopago.noAccess: Mercado Pago did not issue access. Connect Mercado Pago again.
mercadopago.otherAccess: Mercado Pago granted this site other access than reading, so the access was not used.
mercadopago.otherAccount: Mercado Pago issued access for another account. Try again.
mercadopago.notRenewed: Mercado Pago did not renew access. Try again later.
